findings.text: Exposes a classifier that distinguishes compatibility architectures from native ones, returning a truthy value for the former and zero for the latter based on a compatibility predicate applied to the supplied architecture identifier.

Exposes a classifier that first delegates to a compatibility path when the supplied interface is in compatibility mode, otherwise assigns dedicated audit operation codes to a small set of file opening and program execution requests and assigns a native fallback code to every other request, with some request numbers present only under build configuration.

Exposes the compatibility variant of syscall classification, assigning dedicated audit operation codes to the same small set of file opening and program execution requests and assigning a compatibility fallback code to every other request, with some request numbers present only under build configuration.

Boot time initialization entry that registers five audit interest groups covering read, write, directory write, attribute change and signal with the audit filter registry, and additionally registers five thirty two bit compatibility groups when generic compatibility audit support is configured, finally indicating successful completion.

Each of the five native class tables is a persistent unsigned integer list whose entries are supplied by an architecture generic header and whose termination is marked by a maximal unsigned sentinel value.

Exposes an encoder that transforms binary input into text under a caller selected alphabet variant, converting each complete triple of input bytes into four output characters, converting a remaining single byte into two characters and a remaining pair into three characters, optionally appending pad characters to complete the final quantum, and returning the count of characters written without emitting a string terminator.

Exposes a decoder that transforms text into binary under a caller selected variant, converting each complete quadruple of input characters into three output bytes, handling a padded final quadruple only at the very end when padding is enabled, handling short unpadded tails of length two or three only when padding is disabled, and returning the count of bytes written on success or negative one when encountering invalid symbols, misplaced padding, a solitary leftover, or nonzero unused low bits.

Encoding uses three alphabets selected by variant for standard, URL safe and IMAP flavors that share the same alphanumeric prefix and differ only in the last two symbols, while decoding uses three reverse tables selected by the same variant that map valid symbols to six bit values and all other byte values to negative one, constructed through nested doubling helpers that expand a single value rule across the printable range with explicit invalid marking for control and high ranges.
Encoder alphabets each provide sixty five storage slots and decoder reverse maps each provide two hundred fifty six signed slots indexed by raw byte value.
Exposes a conversion from packed decimal byte to binary integer by adding the low nibble value to ten times the high nibble value.

Exposes a conversion from binary integer to packed decimal byte by deriving the tens digit with a scaled multiply and shift approximation and then packing tens and units into high and low nibbles respectively.
Exposes a memory fill that writes a caller supplied byte value repeatedly across a caller supplied region for a caller supplied length and returns the original destination address.

Defines a Galois field polynomial as a degree integer followed by a flexible sequence of unsigned coefficients in increasing term order, with allocation size computed as header size plus one more than the degree times entry size, and provides a degree one specialization that embeds room for exactly two coefficients after the base header.

Field order, correction strength and code length resolve either to build time constants or to fields held in a per instance control structure depending on configuration, and parity extent is derived as the rounded up product of field order and correction strength expressed both in thirty two bit words and in bytes, with a companion maximum word count derived from the configured maxima.

When parameters are dynamic, the supported maxima are fifteen for field order corresponding to a two kilobyte class and sixty four for correction strength corresponding to sixty four bit correction. When parameters are constant, maxima equal the configured constants.

Exposes parity computation over a caller supplied data span that accumulates into an internal word buffer seeded either by translating caller parity bytes or by zeroing, advances through leading unaligned bytes, then through aligned words using four precomputed remainder tables keyed by individual byte lanes with big endian fetch and optional bit reversal, then through trailing bytes, and finally translates the buffer back to caller parity bytes when a destination is supplied.

Byte at a time parity update and translation between byte parity and internal big endian word buffer optionally reverse bit order of each byte under control of a per instance flag, preserve word order during bulk transfer, and zero pad or truncate the final partial word to match the exact parity byte length.

Low level helpers provide modular reduction for arbitrary offsets by repeated subtraction and folding and for single wrap by conditional subtraction, degree by most significant bit position, parity by folding and multiply accumulation, and field multiply square divide inverse and exponentiation plus forward and complemented logarithms all realized through exponent and logarithm tables.

Syndrome generation first clears unused high bits of the last parity word and zeroes twice the correction count accumulators, then for every set bit position accumulates powers of the primitive element at odd multiples of the position offset, then derives even indexed syndromes by squaring the corresponding odd results.

Locator construction iterates up to the correction strength maintaining current and previous polynomials with associated discrepancies and position markers and copying the current state before each update when the discrepancy is nonzero and merging a shifted and scaled copy of the previous state and promoting the copy when degree grows and refreshing the discrepancy from syndromes and current coefficients and emitting debug text and failing when final degree exceeds correction strength. Polynomial copying duplicates header plus coefficient storage sized by source degree.

Binary linear solving performs column wise elimination with row search and swapping, records columns without pivots as free parameters, rewrites the matrix inserting parameter rows while rejecting contradictory systems, validates that the requested solution count matches the power of two of free parameter count, then enumerates every parameter assignment and back substitutes from low rows upward using parity to produce each solution word.

Affine quartic solving builds a small linear system whose first row is the constant term and whose remaining rows combine precomputed power table entries scaled by logarithms of the quadratic and linear coefficients, transposes the matrix under an assumption that field order is below sixteen, and delegates to the binary linear solver requesting exactly four solutions.

Linear finding returns at most one root derived from coefficient logarithms when the constant term is nonzero, while quadratic finding normalizes through a change of variable into a canonical form, accumulates a candidate from trace tables by scanning set bits, verifies the candidate by squaring relation, and on success maps both candidates back through inverse transformation to logarithmic root positions.

Cubic finding normalizes to monic form, multiplies by a shifted linear factor to obtain an affine quartic, solves for four intermediate values and discards the shift to yield up to three logarithmic roots, while quartic finding normalizes to monic form, optionally shifts to remove the linear term and inverts the variable to reach affine form with special handling for zero coefficients, then reverses inversion and shift to yield up to four logarithmic roots.

Logarithmic representation of a divisor maps each nonzero coefficient to its logarithm shifted to normalize the leading term and maps zero to negative one without setting the leading entry, and modular reduction uses either a caller supplied representation or a cached freshly computed one to eliminate high terms by exclusive combination with shifted power table entries, then lowers the degree below the divisor and trims trailing zero coefficients.

Parity computation guards against a parity word requirement larger than a static scratch capacity by issuing a warning and returning without producing output, and diagnostic emission throughout this component is compiled to a no operation.

Decoding helpers impose strict failure modes including rejection of padded input outside the final quantum, rejection of unpadded single leftovers and nonzero unused bits, silent production of zero roots for degenerate zero constant polynomials, and reliance on field order below sixteen for matrix transposition correctness.
